item.title: Liverpool weigh January move for Bayern Munich defender Hiroki Ito
item.description: Liverpool have made initial contact over the Japan international, who has struggled for minutes at Bayern Munich since returning from a foot injury. Any deal would depend on the defender's contract situation, with 18 months left to run.
item.dc:creator: Fabrizio Example

item.title: Kaoru Mitoma out for six weeks with ankle ligament damage
item.description: Brighton's head coach confirmed the Japan winger will miss the next six weeks after scans revealed ligament damage in his right ankle sustained against Everton on Saturday.

item.title: Reims duo Ito and Nakamura shine in Ligue 1 win at Lens
item.description: Stade de Reims moved up to fifth after a 3-1 win, with both Japan internationals scoring in the second half.

item.title: Wembley to host the 2027 Women's Champions League final
item.description: Uefa has confirmed that the showpiece will be staged in London for the first time since 2011, with tickets going on sale in November.
